description: §14.8.10 (S455) — H2: a `<schema>` VIEW over the tenant-scoped `assets` plus an INSTEAD OF UPDATE trigger on it that writes `assets`. Before S455, tenant A's `UPDATE va … WHERE id = 2` rewrote tenant B's row (executed on bade5cb9d). The view and the trigger (declared on a view over a tenant table; its body names `assets`) are each charged.
rationale: §14.8.10 (S455): a `<schema>` that declares, against a tenant-scoped table (one carrying `tenant_id`), a trigger declared on it or whose body names it, a Postgres rule on or naming it, a foreign key with a CASCADE / SET NULL / SET DEFAULT action whose either end is tenant-scoped, or a view (materialized included) reading it directly or through another view, SHALL be a compile error at the declaration (E-TENANT-SCHEMA-HAZARD); a declaration the checker cannot attribute is charged, never treated as safe. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S455 "go, comp-time schema".
